description: I'm Graham Pearce, and after twenty-two years in the Royal Engineers and fifteen more planning for floods, blackouts and shortages as a council emergency planning officer, this channel is where I show you how to get your home and family ready. I cover food and water, staying warm without the grid, backup power, power cuts and winter crises, and how to protect your home if things really go wrong. Everything is practical, British, and based on what I've seen work. I'm not here to frighten you, I'm here to make sure you're ready. Whether you're just starting out or already have a cupboard full of tins, there's something here for you.
